sortieMusters.line: ⚔️ SORTIE — Nino, Dumisani take up arms and a day's rations (4,141 kcal from the stores) and walk out to the treeline. Nobody's coming back the same.

log: Nino has Starfall bow but no arrows — the string stays drawn, useless.
